## Scope

- [ ] Meta provider

## Validation

- [ ] `yarn lint`
- [ ] `yarn typecheck`

- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or production identifiers added
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated when user-visible behavior changed

- [ ] Existing Twenty copyright/license notices preserved
